project.name: correlation-commons
project.description:
Shared CorrelationId/RequestId/MessageId tracing infrastructure (HTTP filter, RabbitMQ MessagePostProcessor, Outbox envelope codec, structured logging helper) used by all four Spring Boot services.
Deliberately not built/installed as part of any service's own build (no reactor `modules` list added to easydora-parent, keeping ADR-0016's decision intact) -- `mvn install` this module once locally, and each Dockerfile installs it in its own build stage before building the service, exactly like a normal Maven dependency resolved from the local repository.
This is a deliberate, scoped exception to this project's general "no shared library between services" convention (see CLAUDE.md and architectural-principles.md): that convention is about business event DTOs, where each service keeping its own copy preserves independent polyglot evolution. This module has no business/domain meaning at all -- it is pure cross-cutting tracing infrastructure that must stay byte-for-byte identical across all four Spring services for the CorrelationId contract to hold, so duplicating it four times would only add maintenance risk (a fix applied to three copies and forgotten in the fourth) with no corresponding independence benefit.
